title: Square of the first Gowers norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Write $\mathbb E_x f(x)$ for the uniform mean of $f$ on $\mathbb F_2^n$. Then the square of the first Gowers norm of $f$ equals the square of its mean: $\|f\|_{U^1}^2=(\mathbb E_x f(x))^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
